service.name: Time
service.purpose: Owns calendar and event data (CalDAV-backed calendar objects: events and tasks), scoped strictly to the authenticated member's own calendar objects. Does not own Social events (social.event, owned by social.elonn) -- Social events synced into a member's calendar arrive here only as ingested calendar objects with a source reference back to Social.

endpoints.purpose: Accept one authenticated canonical Call for Time operations and return one canonical Service Dataset.

operations.purpose: Search the member's own calendar objects (events and tasks) by title, description, or location.
Show the member's recent calendar objects (events and tasks).
Open a single calendar object already identified by a prior Dataset action.

privacy: Calendar object access is scoped to the authenticated member identity supplied by the calling platform service -- every query filters by identity_user_id, no cross-member visibility exists.

errors.message: Authenticated Conductor or Mind service request is required.
Time Call requires authenticated member identity.
